newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Universal Robina completes $100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Universal Robina completes $100 mln bond.

text.p: Universal Robina Corp unit Universal Robina (Cayman) Ltd's US$100 million guaranteed notes issue due 2006 has been successfully completed, lead manager Merrill Lynch Far East said on Friday.
The notes are unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed by Universal Robina Corp.
Merrill said the offering marks the first-ever unrated 10-year issue for a Philippine company.
The notes were issued at par and carry a coupon of 8.375 percent, which represent a spread of 200 basis points over the relevant U.S. Treasury bond.
Fees are 87.5 basis points split as 37.5 basis points for management and underwriting and 50 basis points for selling concession.
Co-managers are Chase Manhattan International, Dresdner Bank Hong Kong branch and SBC Warburg.
The notes are now free to trade, Merrill said.
